Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about setting up your autonomous agent.

How does the agent hide competitor broker comments in 0.05 seconds?

Algorise AI establishes a persistent, high-frequency Meta Graph API webhook subscription. As soon as a user submits a comment on your Facebook or Instagram ad, our regex engine detects phone number patterns (10-digit, +91, space-separated) and immediately executes an automated Graph API mutation to set the comment to is_hidden: true before competitors can scrape it.

Can the agent speak natural Surati Gujarati and Hindi?

Yes. Unlike generic chatbot builders, Algorise AI is specifically calibrated with regional trade datasets, allowing it to converse naturally in Gujarati, Hindi, and English while understanding local commercial terms like Taako, Loom rate, Cut, Carat, and Ex-factory pricing.

Why do we charge a 20% advance booking fee?

The 20% advance (₹2,499 for Starter, ₹5,999 for Pro, ₹13,000 for Enterprise) reserves your engineering onboarding window and provisions your dedicated Meta Cloud API and Telegram webhooks. You only pay the remaining 80% balance post-launch after you inspect the agent working live on your page.

How fast can we go live?

Turnaround is strictly within 24 to 48 hours of receiving your catalog or price list and Meta Page connection.
